description.from: Rust library API: list/open sessions across agents, filter by agent, kind, time, and project; JSON and JSONL export of the unified history. Specs first: features/03_query_export/*.feature; implementation generated from the specs.
description.to: Querying implemented with SQLite and the sqlite-vec extension underneath. The engine is completely invisible to callers: one query interface, with different query functions on one class and SQLite underneath, so callers never see which engine is running. Supersedes the old property-based filtering over in-memory objects from the former features/03_query_export chapter. Implementation of record: BOTSPY-c7795b (Local Store Initiative). Specs first: features/02_querying/*.feature.
